description: 해양수산부_지능형해양수산재난정보체계_대상선박정보 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 이 데이터는 해양수산부에서 특별 관리 대상으로 지정한 선박의 정보를 체계적으로 관리하기 위해 수집된 데이터입니다. 본 데이터의 주요 내용은 해양수산부 특별관리 대상 선박의 선박번호(MMSI), 선박명, IMO번호, 선박호출번호, 선박의 종류, 선박의 길이 및 깊이 선박 정보와 현재 사용여부, 정보 입력... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 선박, 특별관리, 재난, 선박번호, 선박명. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
